status: Proposed. Every value here is an illustrative default until Rex confirms it and it is fixed in the ratification contract for Block 0. After that, a value changes only by amendment (AMENDMENTS.md). No API route changes it.

batch.label: illustrative
batch.source: MASTER_SPEC Part C1: L1 contracts do not batch; they seal as soon as a jury rules

warmupMaxPct.label: illustrative
warmupMaxPct.source: MASTER_SPEC Part C1: value rule at warm-up no more than 10% of block cost (minRequestsForWarmup in packages/economics)

maxWaitSeconds.label: illustrative
maxWaitSeconds.source: MASTER_SPEC Part C1: the oldest funded contract waits at most 3,600 s

idleReserveUsd.label: illustrative
idleReserveUsd.source: Fixed cost per block for idle GPU hours, on top of warm-up. Zero until a proving operator measures idle time (Part D)

preset.label: illustrative
preset.source: packages/economics preset used to model a block: L2, FlashProve, unpacked

usdPerUnit.label: illustrative
usdPerUnit.source: Stablecoins counted at one US dollar when checking that the queue covers a block. Escrow in any other currency does not count toward the value rule until a price source is chosen

proofDeadlineSeconds.label: illustrative
proofDeadlineSeconds.source: MASTER_SPEC Part D1: after the reveal, each counted juror attaches its proof hash and uploads the proof before this deadline, or its vote is dropped and a no-proof fault is recorded against its bond

verifier.label: illustrative
verifier.source: The Verifier the devnet nodes run (packages/prove in verafyHarness). mock binds commitment, input and answer but is not a proof; deepprove and flashprove adapters exist behind the same interface

threshold.label: illustrative
threshold.source: Shares needed to open a queued contract: more than half the node set (2 of 3 on the devnet)

clockSkewSeconds.label: illustrative
clockSkewSeconds.source: How far ahead of its own clock a node lets the time rule run when it checks a close, the same skew it allows a block's time

size.label: illustrative
size.source: Seats on the screening panel. Article 3.1 sets no number; any value is proposed until fixed in the ratification contract. The code refuses fewer than 3

minLabs.label: illustrative
minLabs.source: Labs the screening panel spans ("several labs", Article 3.1). The code refuses fewer than 2

quorum.label: illustrative
quorum.source: Reveals the screening panel needs to rule: more than half, so one offline panelist does not turn a clear case into a close call

size.label: illustrative
size.source: Seats on the wider ethics panel a close call escalates to (Article 3.3), none of whom sat on the first panel. The code refuses a wider panel no larger than the first

quorum.label: illustrative
quorum.source: Reveals the wider panel needs to rule: more than half

bar.label: illustrative
bar.source: Two thirds: the bar each ethics panel must clear. Article 3 sets no bar; two thirds matches the draft constitution and ethics check panels in AMENDMENTS.md. The code refuses a bar of one half or less

fee.label: illustrative
fee.source: Escrow for each screening panel, in the subject's own coin, posted beside the contract escrow so a refused contract gets its whole escrow back (Article 3.2). Who funds it is a decision for Rex

split.label: illustrative
split.source: How a screening panel's escrow is paid out, the same split as the example contracts

amendments.status: Proposed draft values from AMENDMENTS.md, Draft 0. Fixed only in the ratification contract for Block 0; after that, changed only by a Supersede amendment at the high bar. None is measured.

constitutionCheck.label: proposed
constitutionCheck.source: AMENDMENTS.md, Constitution check panel: 7 harnesses, at least 4 labs, bar 2/3 (proposed)

ethicsCheck.label: proposed
ethicsCheck.source: AMENDMENTS.md, Ethics check panel: 7 harnesses, at least 4 labs, bar 2/3 (proposed)

merit.label: proposed
merit.source: AMENDMENTS.md, Merit panel: 15 harnesses, at least 5 labs; bar 3/4 for Extend and Clarify, 4/5 for Reclassify and Supersede (proposed)

challengeWindowDays.label: proposed
challengeWindowDays.source: AMENDMENTS.md, Challenge: window 14 days after an adopt ruling (proposed)

challenge.label: illustrative
challenge.source: AMENDMENTS.md, Challenge panel: 21 harnesses, at least 6 labs (proposed). AMENDMENTS.md sets no challenge bar; 2/3 is illustrative and needs Rex

escalationsPerStage.label: proposed
escalationsPerStage.source: AMENDMENTS.md: 1 escalation per stage, then doubt resolves toward stopping (proposed). The wider panel is core's escalate default, 2n - 1 seats, excluding everyone who sat before

stageShare.label: illustrative
stageShare.source: Share of the amendment escrow each panel stage is paid. AMENDMENTS.md says the escrow pays every panel and the rest returns to the proposer, but sets no split; these shares are illustrative and need Rex. The challenge panel is paid by the challenger

split.label: illustrative
split.source: How a stage panel's escrow is paid out
